policy.inputs: New text-only AI music plus original procedural UI synthesis only. Cue sheets provide timing metadata, never reference samples.
policy.selection: Explicit sparse editorial subset; one effect per selected event. No beat doubling, notification cascade, or automatic typing cluster expansion.
policy.normalization: FFmpeg loudnorm measured common static gain; when the static true-peak cap misses the target by more than1LU, apply a shared4x-oversampled lookahead limiter to music/SFX/sum, preserving stem additivity. SFX is never independently normalized.
